risks.title: Money stored and summed as binary floats
risks.chain: Cause: amounts are Python floats. Event: decimal amounts are summed. Consequence: totals such as 0.30000000000000004 appear in text/JSON reports.
risks.ev: docs/evidence/03_baseline_probes.txt P1: total() = 0.30000000000000004; still present in 07_final_probes.txt P1.
risks.mit: Not implemented. Plan: store integer minor units or decimal.Decimal and round at output.
risks.ver: Unit test: add 0.1 and 0.2, expect exactly 0.30 in every format.
risks.resid: Open. Not touched by M1/M2 (M1 rejects NaN/inf but does not fix rounding).

risks.title: No input validation in Tracker.add
risks.chain: Cause: add() stored any value. Event: user enters -250, 0, a blank category, or nan/inf. Consequence: wrong totals; a stored NaN makes total() NaN permanently because it is persisted in the data file.
risks.ev: 03_baseline_probes.txt P2: total() = nan, negative/zero/blank items stored.
risks.mit: M1: validate amount (finite number > 0, not bool) and category (non-blank string); raise ValueError before anything is stored; CLI prints error and exits 2.
risks.ver: tests/test_risks.py::TestR02Validation (6 tests); probe P2; CLI smoke log (exit=2, no file created).
risks.resid: Low. Data files edited by hand, and direct writes to Tracker.items, still bypass validation. Refunds (negative amounts) are intentionally unsupported.

risks.title: CSV formula injection
risks.chain: Cause: CSV is built by string join and user text is written verbatim. Event: a description or category starting with = + - @ is opened in a spreadsheet. Consequence: the cell can be evaluated as a formula in the recipient's spreadsheet.
risks.ev: 03_baseline_probes.txt P4: output row 5,food,=HYPERLINK("http://evil.example","click"). Actual opening in Excel/LibreOffice was NOT performed.
risks.mit: M2: build CSV with the csv module and prefix ' to text cells that start with = + - @ tab or CR.
risks.ver: tests/test_risks.py::TestR03CsvSafety (5 tests, 4 prefix subtests); probe P4 shows leading '.
risks.resid: Low-medium. The apostrophe convention was verified only at text level, not in a real spreadsheet; legitimate text starting with these characters gains a visible quote.

risks.title: CSV breaks when text contains commas or quotes
risks.chain: Cause: manual '%s,%s,%s' join without quoting. Event: description such as 'lunch, with friends'. Consequence: rows parse into 4 columns instead of 3.
risks.mit: Fixed as a side effect of M2 (csv.writer quoting). Not counted as one of the two required mitigations.

risks.title: Corrupted data file crashes the program
risks.chain: Cause: json.load is not guarded. Event: expenses.json is truncated or hand-edited incorrectly. Consequence: every command fails with a traceback; no recovery message.
risks.mit: Not implemented. Candidate for the background-agent task in Task 8: catch JSONDecodeError, report a clear error, leave the file untouched.
risks.ver: New test that writes a truncated file and expects a clear error and an unchanged file.

risks.title: Non-atomic save can lose data on a crash
risks.chain: Cause: open(path, 'w') truncates the file before json.dump completes. Event: process killed or disk full during save. Consequence: previous data lost.
risks.ev: Static only: git grep shows open(self.path, "w") (09_unsupported_claims_checks.txt). A crash during save was NOT simulated.
risks.mit: Not implemented. Write to a temp file and os.replace().
risks.ver: Fault-injection test (patch json.dump to raise) and check the original file is intact.

risks.title: No lint, type check, CI or pinned toolchain
risks.chain: Cause: no pyproject/requirements/CI in the repository. Event: an agent changes code. Consequence: only unittest and compileall can catch mistakes; style/type regressions go unnoticed.
risks.ev: 02_baseline_checks.txt: pytest, ruff, mypy, flake8 not installed; ls shows no pyproject.toml, requirements*.txt or .github.
risks.mit: Not implemented. A stdlib stand-in (tools/simple_lint.py) was added but is not equivalent to ruff/mypy.
risks.ver: CI workflow running unittest + a pinned linter + type checker on every push.

risks.title: Platform-dependent file encoding
risks.chain: Cause: open() is called without encoding=. Event: non-ASCII category (for example Cyrillic) saved on a system whose default encoding is not UTF-8. Consequence: mojibake or UnicodeEncodeError.
risks.ev: Static only: three open() calls without encoding (09_unsupported_claims_checks.txt). Not tested on Windows.
risks.ver: Run a non-ASCII round-trip test on Windows.
